text.en: This Notification may be cited as the Prisons (Consolidation) Notification. Declaration of prisons.

The places described in the Schedule are hereby declared to be prisons for the purposes of the Prisons Act for the imprisonment or detention of persons lawfully in custody —

SCHEDULE (paragraph 2)

PRISONS Jerudong (Male) Prison Jerudong (Female) Prison Penjara Maraburong
